name: The orc internment camp on the road to Dalaran (Jaina's memory)
region: Lordaeron, on the road to Dalaran, years before the story; within sight of the escort's night halt

sensoryProfile.sight: A palisade fence of stakes with a watchtower; a gap in the bracken under the tower that nobody watches; wet fern; orcs lying by fires gone out, great grey shoulders under blankets; a hut, and against its wall a female orc rocking an infant on her lap, its small fist holding one of her tusks.
sensoryProfile.sound: Arthas whispering all the way; the female humming something low.
sensoryProfile.smell: Wet fern; not described beyond that.
sensoryProfile.touch: Elbows crawling through wet fern; wet on the knees at the tent door.
sensoryProfile.atmosphere: A boy's dare, certainty, and a sight that does not fit the certainty.

establishedFacts.fact: The year Jaina went to Dalaran her escort stopped for the night within sight of an orc internment camp. After the fire was banked Arthas scratched at her tent wall and dared her to crawl past the watchtower to look. She called him certain; he called her frightened; she went. At the fence she saw females and infants. He was as sure at the tent door as before.
This memory is Jaina's alone. Sylvanas has not heard it and does not ask.

eventsHere.event: Triggered by 'Out of the camps' at Strahnbrad; Jaina asks whether she was unfair to him; answers 'No.'
